high_level_description: This image is a pie chart from Nielsen's "The Gauge," which provides a snapshot of total TV and streaming usage in May 2025. The chart is divided into several segments representing different types of media consumption, with their respective percentages. Title and Source: The title at the top reads: "The Gauge™ Nielsen’s Total TV and Streaming Snapshot." The source is credited to Nielsen National TV Panel plus Streaming Platform Ratings. The copyright notice is for The Nielsen Company, dated 2025. Main Pie Chart: The
